experiments.name: Microgravity Protein Crystal Growth & Cell Inoculation
experiments.description: Validation of macromolecular crystallography and recombinant enzyme crystallization kinetics under microgravity conditions on-board Bharatiya Antariksh Station.

steps.title: Glovebox Negative Pressure Seal Check
steps.instructions: Inspect glovebox containment gasket. Rotate secondary seal latch 90° clockwise. Verify negative delta-P reads > 25 Pa on digital rack readout.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 1: Glovebox containment check. Verify latch seal and confirm negative pressure differential.

steps.title: Retrieve Cryo-Vial from -80°C Stowage
steps.instructions: Open Cryo-Rack door B2. Use insulated tongs to extract Lysozyme crystallization precursor vial #CY-104. Place into thermal equilibration dock.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 2: Retrieve Cryo-Vial from minus eighty stowage using insulated tongs.

steps.title: Precision Micropipetting (100 µL Buffer Transfer)
steps.instructions: Calibrate micropipette to 100 µL. Aspirate precipitant buffer without introducing microgravity air bubble cavitation. Dispense into hanging-drop capillary well.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 3: Precision micropipetting. Transfer 100 microliters buffer slowly to prevent microgravity bubbling.

steps.title: Centrifuge Rotor Loading & Counterbalance
steps.instructions: CRITICAL SAFETY: Place sample tube in Slot 1. Place matching counterweight tube in diametrically opposed Slot 4. Inspect balance indicator.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 4: Load sample and counterbalance into micro-centrifuge. Both tubes must be diametrically balanced.

steps.title: Secure Rotor Latch & Initiate 3500 RPM Cycle
steps.instructions: Lower safety shield until magnetic interlock engages. Enter 3500 RPM / 180s on digital rotary console. Confirm rotor speed telemetry.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 5: Lock safety lid and start 3500 RPM centrifuge cycle.

steps.title: Spectrophotometric Optical Density Scan
steps.instructions: Transfer crystal well to optical chamber. Run wavelength sweep at 280 nm. Log baseline absorption peak to on-board data store.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 6: Optical density scan. Place crystal well into spectrophotometer and record 280 nm absorption.

steps.title: Specimen Hermetic Sealing & Cryo-Vault Archival
steps.instructions: Seal sample cassette with vacuum clip. Return to Cryo-Stowage slot C-04. Confirm temperature latch status is locked.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 7: Final step. Hermetically seal sample cassette and return to cryo-stowage for Earth return.

experiments.name: High-Vacuum Directional Alloy Solidification
experiments.description: Solidification microstructural analysis of Ti-Al aerospace superalloy in microgravity to eliminate gravity-induced convection and buoyancy defects.

steps.title: Argon Purge & Thermal Shield Verification
steps.instructions: Purge vacuum chamber with ultra-pure Argon. Verify shield cooling flow > 1.2 L/min.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 1: Material furnace argon purge and thermal shield verification.

steps.title: Insert Superalloy Ingot into Ceramic Core
steps.instructions: Slide Ti-Al sample into quartz heating zone. Align thermocouple beads 1 through 4.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 2: Insert superalloy specimen into ceramic heating core.

steps.title: Laser Pyrometer Alignment & Calibration
steps.instructions: Zero dual-wavelength optical pyrometer. Verify target crosshair is centered on crucible aperture.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 3: Calibrate laser pyrometer alignment to crucible aperture.

steps.title: Rapid Quench Gas Actuation & Lock
steps.instructions: Rotate cryogenic Helium quench lever. Confirm temperature drops at > 80°C/s.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 4: Actuate quench cooling valve and lock chamber.

experiments.name: Astronaut Physiological Blood Hematocrit Separation
experiments.description: On-board microgravity blood analysis to monitor astronaut erythrocyte morphology, hemoglobin count, and immune response during long-duration orbital flight.

steps.title: Sterile Field & Containment Prep
steps.instructions: Sanitize glove ports with antiseptic wipe. Deploy magnetic instrument retainers so items do not float away in microgravity.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 1: Sanitize biomedical glovebox and deploy magnetic tool anchors.

steps.title: Micro-Capillary Blood Sampling
steps.instructions: Collect 50 µL capillary sample into heparinized micro-tube. Seal capillary ends with sealing clay wax.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 2: Collect capillary blood sample into heparinized tube and wax-seal both ends.

steps.title: Micro-Centrifuge Hematocrit Separation
steps.instructions: Mount capillary tube with wax seal against outer gasket. Spin for 5 minutes at 12000 RPM. Verify plasma/RBC boundary interface.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 3: Load micro-centrifuge and initiate high-speed hematocrit separation.

steps.title: Digital Bio-Analyzer Digital Readout
steps.instructions: Insert separated tube into optical reader. Measure packed cell volume percentage. Record telemetry to station memory.
steps.voice_prompt: Step 4: Scan hematocrit tube with digital optical reader and record telemetry.
